title: Causal attributions shape the formation of novel ability self-beliefs.
summary: Healthy individuals typically attribute success to internal and failure to external factors, while people with depression and low self-esteem tend to do the opposite. At the same time, depression and low self-esteem are associated with negatively biased self-related learning and self-beliefs. Here, we used a validated self-related learning task to investigate how internal versus external attributions of performance feedback affect the formation of self-beliefs about ability and how these processes relate to depressive symptoms and self-esteem. Drawing on a computational model that incorporates prediction error valence and causal attributions, we found that participants updated their ability beliefs less when feedback was attributed to external causes. Furthermore, individuals with higher levels of depression and lower self-esteem showed a stronger negativity bias in learning and lower self-esteem was linked to a reduced self-serving attributional bias. These findings provide insight into cognitive mechanisms associated with negative self-related ability beliefs and may help to inform our understanding of processes linked to depressive symptoms.

标题：因果归因塑造了新型能力自我信念的形成
摘要：健康个体通常将成功归因于内部因素，将失败归因于外部因素，而抑郁和低自尊个体则往往相反。同时，抑郁和低自尊与自我相关学习及自我信念的消极偏差相关。本研究采用经过验证的自我相关学习任务，探究绩效反馈的内部与外部归因如何影响关于能力的自我信念形成，以及这些过程与抑郁症状和自尊的关系。基于一个整合了预测误差效价和因果归因的计算模型，我们发现，当反馈被归因于外部原因时，参与者更新其能力信念的程度较低。此外，抑郁水平较高和自尊水平较低的个体在学习中表现出更强的消极偏差，而自尊水平较低与自利归因偏差减弱相关。这些发现揭示了与消极的自我相关能力信念相关的认知机制，并可能有助于我们理解与抑郁症状相关的心理过程。
关键词：因果归因；自我信念；抑郁症状；自尊；计算模型

title: Intelligent emotion and behavior recognition for online learners using deep affective computing.
summary: Teachers in online classes often have limited visibility into how students are feeling and whether they are staying engaged. This paper presents a practical affective-computing framework that analyses webcam video to recognize both facial emotions and learning-centered behavioral states during live virtual sessions. Student faces are first detected in each frame, then encoded using a convolutional network with an attention module to emphasize informative facial regions. To capture how affect evolves over time, the extracted features are grouped into fixed 16-frame sequences and modelled with a bidirectional GRU to predict four behavioral states: engaged, confused, frustrated and disengaged. We evaluate emotion recognition on the FER2013 benchmark under the standard Train/Public Test/Private Test split, and we evaluate behavior recognition on a publicly available online-learning facial expression dataset (EmoDetect, Kaggle) used for the behavior-recognition experiments from 120 learners (800 annotated temporal segments; inter-annotator agreement κ≈0.75). The proposed model reaches 94.5% accuracy on FER2013 Private Test and achieves 86.9% accuracy with a macro-F1 of 85.4% on the four-class behavior task, improving over facial-expression-only baselines. Profiling further shows that the full pipeline can run at around 25 frames per second on a mid-range GPU, indicating feasibility for real-time monitoring. These results suggest that combining attention-based facial representations with temporal modelling can provide instructors with clearer, webcam-observable indicators of learners' affect and engagement during online teaching.

标题：基于深度情感计算的在线学习者情绪与行为识别  
摘要：在线课堂中，教师通常难以充分了解学生的情绪状态及其是否保持专注。本文提出一种实用的情感计算框架，通过分析网络摄像头视频，在实时虚拟课堂中识别面部情绪及以学习为中心的行为状态。首先检测每帧中的学生面部，并使用带有注意力机制的卷积网络进行编码，以突出信息丰富的面部区域。为捕捉情感随时间演变的动态特征，将提取的特征分组为固定长度为16帧的序列，并通过双向门控循环单元进行建模，以预测四种行为状态：专注、困惑、沮丧和分心。我们在FER2013基准数据集的标准训练集/公开测试集/私有测试集划分下评估情绪识别性能；并在公开的在线学习面部表情数据集（EmoDetect, Kaggle）上评估行为识别性能，该数据集包含来自120名学习者的800个带注释的时间段（标注者间一致性κ≈0.75）。所提模型在FER2013私有测试集上达到94.5%的准确率，在四类行为任务上实现86.9%的准确率和85.4%的宏平均F1分数，优于仅基于面部表情的基线方法。性能分析进一步表明，完整流程在中端GPU上可达到约25帧/秒的运行速度，表明其具备实时监控的可行性。这些结果表明，将基于注意力的面部表征与时间建模相结合，可为教师提供清晰且可通过网络摄像头观察的在线教学中学员情感与投入状态指标。  
关键词：情感计算；面部表情识别；行为识别；深度学习；在线学习

title: Behavioral and emotional abnormalities in mice with orthotopic colitis-associated colorectal cancer.
summary:
BACKGROUND: Colorectal cancer (CRC) is usually accompanied by emotional and behavioral changes in patients, yet the underlying neurobiological mechanisms remain unclear. There is a lack of robust experimental models to investigate how tumor progression may influence brain function and behavior.
METHODS: The azoxymethane (AOM) and dextran sulfate sodium (DSS) were used to induce the orthotopic colitis-associated CRC (CAC) mouse models. Then we performed a range of behavioral tests including the sucrose preference test (SPT), elevated plus maze (EPM), tail suspension test (TST), novel object recognition test (NORT), resident-intruder assay, and tube test to evaluate abnormal behaviors of depression, memory impairment, and irritability.
RESULTS: CAC mice exhibited a marked reduction in body weight accompanied by pronounced colon shortening. Histopathological examination using hematoxylin and eosin staining revealed the presence of colonic adenomas and atypical hyperplasia. Behavioral tests using the EPM and TST indicated heightened depressive-like behavior, while the NORT revealed significant memory impairment compared to controls. Meanwhile, the resident-intruder assay and tube tests showed that CAC mice exhibited irritability and aggression. TUNEL staining showed a marked increase in TUNEL-positive cells in the hippocampus of CAC mice, while Western blots revealed downregulated anti-apoptotic Bcl-2 and upregulated pro-apoptotic Bak, Bad, and cleaved PARP. Real-time quantitative polymerase chain reaction further revealed increased expression of IL-6 and IBA-1 in the hippocampus of CAC mice.
CONCLUSION: The AOM/DSS-induced CAC mouse model recapitulates tumor-associated behavioral and neurobiological alterations, underscoring its application in neuropsychiatric oncology research.

标题：原位结肠炎相关结直肠癌小鼠的行为与情绪异常
摘要：背景：结直肠癌患者常伴有情绪和行为改变，但其潜在的神经生物学机制尚不清楚。目前缺乏稳健的实验模型来研究肿瘤进展如何影响大脑功能和行为。
方法：使用氧化偶氮甲烷（AOM）和硫酸葡聚糖钠（DSS）诱导原位结肠炎相关结直肠癌（CAC）小鼠模型。随后进行一系列行为测试，包括蔗糖偏好实验（SPT）、高架十字迷宫实验（EPM）、悬尾实验（TST）、新物体识别实验（NORT）、居住者-入侵者实验和管式实验，以评估抑郁、记忆障碍和易激惹等异常行为。
结果：CAC小鼠表现出明显的体重下降和结肠缩短。苏木精-伊红染色组织病理学检查显示结肠腺瘤和非典型增生。行为测试中，EPM和TST表明抑郁样行为增加，NORT显示与对照组相比存在显著记忆障碍。同时，居住者-入侵者实验和管式实验表明CAC小鼠表现出易激惹和攻击性。TUNEL染色显示CAC小鼠海马区TUNEL阳性细胞显著增加，而Western blot检测发现抗凋亡蛋白Bcl-2下调，促凋亡蛋白Bak、Bad和裂解型PARP上调。实时定量聚合酶链反应进一步揭示CAC小鼠海马区IL-6和IBA-1表达增加。
结论：AOM/DSS诱导的CAC小鼠模型重现了肿瘤相关的行为和神经生物学改变，突显了其在神经精神病学肿瘤学研究中的应用价值。
关键词：结直肠癌；情绪异常；行为异常；小鼠模型；抑郁样行为

title: Neural correlates of rumination in psychiatric disorders: A systematic review of fMRI evidence.
summary:
BACKGROUND: Rumination is a transdiagnostic, persistent factor across many psychiatric conditions. Mapping its neural mechanisms may help differentiate ruminative profiles.
OBJECTIVE: To systematically review fMRI studies that evaluated rumination in psychiatric populations METHODS: We searched four databases (PubMed, EMBASE, Web of Science, Scopus) and included studies that integrated rumination measures with fMRI data.
RESULTS: Thirty-two articles met criteria; most were non-randomized (n = 31, 97%) and focused on depression (n = 24, 75%). Across disorders, clinical groups showed higher rumination than healthy controls, including in euthymic participants. In major depressive disorder, neural alterations implicated the default mode network, limbic and striatal regions, dorsolateral prefrontal cortex, and anterior cingulate cortex consistent with maladaptive ongoing processing. Neural signatures often persisted in remitted patients, suggesting possible trait markers of vulnerability. Intervention studies (n = 7) support using neuroimaging to track ruminative profiles and to inform more personalized interventions.
CONCLUSION: This review highlights the importance of examining rumination, here measured via trait questionnaires, state-induction paradigms, cognitive tasks, or resting-state fMRI, using more consistent conceptual and methodological approaches. Although rumination is transdiagnostic, implicated brain regions and networks may show disorder-specific patterns. Given heterogeneity in the literature, future work should prioritize controlled and interventional studies to clarify neural mechanisms and guide circuit-based, targeted treatments. PROSPERO REGISTRATION: #CRD532512.

标题：精神障碍中反刍思维的神经关联：一项fMRI证据的系统综述
摘要：背景：反刍思维是多种精神疾病中一种跨诊断的持续性因素。绘制其神经机制可能有助于区分反刍思维的特征模式。目的：系统评价在精神疾病人群中评估反刍思维的fMRI研究。方法：检索四个数据库（PubMed、EMBASE、Web of Science、Scopus），纳入结合了反刍思维测量与fMRI数据的研究。结果：32篇文章符合标准；大多数为非随机研究（n=31，97%），且聚焦于抑郁症（n=24，75%）。在不同疾病中，临床组的反刍思维水平高于健康对照组，包括情绪平稳期患者。在重度抑郁症中，神经改变涉及默认模式网络、边缘系统和纹状体区、背外侧前额叶皮层和前扣带皮层，与适应不良的持续加工过程一致。神经特征在缓解期患者中常持续存在，提示可能存在易感性的特质标志物。干预研究（n=7）支持使用神经影像学追踪反刍思维谱系，并为更个性化的干预提供依据。结论：本综述强调了使用更一致的概念和方法学方法研究反刍思维的重要性，此处通过特质问卷、状态诱导范式、认知任务或静息态fMRI进行测量。尽管反刍思维是跨诊断的，但涉及的脑区和网络可能显示出疾病特异性模式。鉴于文献中的异质性，未来研究应优先开展对照和干预研究，以阐明神经机制并指导基于回路的靶向治疗。PROSPERO注册号：CRD532512。
关键词：反刍思维；fMRI；神经关联；精神疾病；跨诊断

title: The role of prefrontal cortex in emotion regulation: A more naturalistic magnetoencephalographic study.
summary: Emotion regulation is aimed to control emotional states through various strategies, among which reappraisal and suppression have been extensively studied up to date. Nevertheless, physiological correlates of this process are still debatable, since findings on both brain and peripheral activity are contradictory. In the present work, we were first to investigate neural sources and inter-subject correlations (a measure of synchronized neural activity) during natural watching of neutral and negative one-minute videos, regulation via reappraisal and suppression strategies utilizing magnetoencephalography. In the results, first, free watching of negative videos led to a higher average inter-subject correlation compared to the other conditions, including the regulatory ones, which indicates higher neural synchrony between subjects. Second, we also revealed an increased inter-subject correlation during usage of both reappraisal and suppression strategies, but in relation to the specific sources of neural activity. A number of identified sources were located in the prefrontal cortex, which potentially implies the involvement of this area in emotion regulation, regardless of applied strategies. In summary, different neural patterns (especially, frontal) of synchrony in relation to negative emotion experience and regulation processes using naturalistic stimuli were demonstrated by means of magnetoencephalographic neuroimaging.

标题：前额叶皮层在情绪调节中的作用：一项更自然化的脑磁图研究
摘要：情绪调节旨在通过各种策略控制情绪状态，其中重新评估和抑制是目前被广泛研究的策略。然而，这一过程的生理相关性仍存有争议，因为关于大脑和外周活动的发现相互矛盾。在本研究中，我们首次利用脑磁图技术，在自然观看中性及负性一分钟视频、以及通过重新评估和抑制策略进行调节的过程中，探究了神经来源和受试者间相关性（一种同步神经活动的测量指标）。结果显示：第一，与包括调节条件在内的其他条件相比，自由观看负性视频导致更高的平均受试者间相关性，表明受试者之间的神经同步性更高。第二，我们还发现，在使用重新评估和抑制策略时，受试者间相关性增加，但这与特定的神经活动来源相关。多个被识别的神经来源位于前额叶皮层，这暗示该区域参与情绪调节，与所采用的策略无关。总之，通过脑磁图神经成像，本研究展示了在自然刺激条件下，与负性情绪体验和情绪调节过程相关的不同神经同步模式（尤其是额叶区域）。
关键词：情绪调节；前额叶皮层；脑磁图；受试者间相关性；自然刺激

title: Left hippocampal subiculum-hypothalamus hyperconnectivity as a neural correlate of stress vulnerability.
summary:
BACKGROUND: The neurobiological mechanisms underlying individual differences in susceptibility to depression remain unclear. This study combined behavioral tests and resting-state functional magnetic resonance imaging (r-fMRI) to investigate how chronic unpredictable mild stress (CUMS) affects brain function and behavior in rats, and to identify neural markers that distinguish depression-susceptible (SUS) from resilient (RES) individuals.
METHODS: Thirty-one rats (CTRL group, n = 9; CUMS group, n = 22) underwent baseline r-fMRI scans before CUMS exposure. After 5 weeks of CUMS, behavioral tests, including sucrose preference test (SPT), forced swim test (FST), open field test (OFT), elevated plus maze (EPM), and novel object recognition test (NORT) were conducted, followed by post-stress r-fMRI. Rats were classified into SUS and RES groups based primarily on SPT and FST performance.
RESULTS: CUMS induced depression-like behaviors in SUS rats, such as reduced sucrose preference, while RES rats remained comparable to controls. RsFC analysis revealed that SUS rats exhibited enhanced functional connectivity between the hippocampal subiculum and right hypothalamus/left hypothalamus after CUMS. Critically, at baseline, SUS rats already showed stronger left subiculum-left hypothalamic connectivity than RES rats, a difference not observed on the right side.
CONCLUSION: These findings reveal that individual susceptibility to depression is associated with distinct patterns of functional connectivity involving the hippocampal subiculum, hypothalamus, and amygdala. Critically, pre-existing hyperconnectivity between the left subiculum and left medial hypothalamus may distinguish SUS from RES rats before stress exposure. This specific neural signature may represent a potential vulnerability factor and could inform the development of biomarkers for early risk identification.

标题：左侧海马下托-下丘脑超连接作为应激易感性的神经相关指标  
摘要：背景：抑郁症个体差异背后的神经生物学机制仍不清楚。本研究结合行为测试和静息态功能磁共振成像（r-fMRI），探讨慢性不可预测温和应激（CUMS）如何影响大鼠的脑功能和行为，并识别区分抑郁易感（SUS）与应激抵抗（RES）个体的神经标志物。方法：31只大鼠（对照组，n=9；CUMS组，n=22）在CUMS暴露前接受基线r-fMRI扫描。经历5周CUMS后，进行行为测试（包括糖水偏好测试、强迫游泳测试、旷场测试、高架十字迷宫测试和新物体识别测试），随后进行应激后r-fMRI。主要根据糖水偏好测试和强迫游泳测试表现将大鼠分为SUS和RES组。结果：CUMS诱导SUS大鼠出现抑郁样行为（如糖水偏好降低），而RES大鼠与对照组相当。静息态功能连接分析显示，SUS大鼠在CUMS后海马下托与右侧下丘脑/左侧下丘脑之间的功能连接增强。关键在于，基线状态下SUS大鼠已表现出左侧下托-左侧下丘脑连接强于RES大鼠，而右侧未观察到这一差异。结论：这些发现表明，抑郁症的个体易感性与涉及海马下托、下丘脑和杏仁核的不同功能连接模式相关。关键的是，左侧下托与左侧内侧下丘脑之间预先存在的超连接可能在应激暴露前区分SUS与RES大鼠。这一特异性神经标志可能代表潜在的脆弱因素，并为早期风险识别的生物标志物开发提供依据。  
关键词：抑郁症易感性；海马下托；下丘脑；功能连接；应激脆弱性
